name: Steamhouse India Ltd
title: Steamhouse India Ltd - 544914 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Steam volumes up 16.7% YoY with utilisation 41.40% (from 36.06%) and EBITDA/ton ₹1,011, but ~70% of 345 TPH is contracted and capacity is being added toward 705 TPH.

utilisation.quote: Utilization increased to 41.40% in Q1FY2027 from 36.06% in Q1-FY2026 and 38.32% in Q4-FY2026.

triggers.label: Utilisation 36.06% → 41.40% YoY
triggers.quote: Utilization increased to 41.40% in Q1FY2027 from 36.06% in Q1-FY2026

triggers.label: Capacity 345 → 705 TPH planned
triggers.quote: expansion from the current 345 tons per hour capacity towards approximately 705 tons per hour capacity

triggers.label: EBITDA/ton ₹737 → ₹1,011
triggers.quote: EBITDA per ton increased by 37.17% to INR1,011 in Quarter 1 FY27 from INR737 per ton in Q1 FY26

triggers.label: Volumes +16.7% YoY
triggers.quote: steam volumes reaching a record quarterly level of approximately 3,05,816 tons, representing a growth of 16.70% year -on-year

guidance.quote: we can expect similar growth in at least, say, 5% to 10% for the current locations
Our intent is to take this utilization to 60 % to 65%
EBITDA per ton of INR1,000 can be safely assumed that it will be maintained
four under-construction facilities should go live in current financial year, this is what we are targeting
The 60 tons per hour capacity, which is in Tarapur, should get live in Q4-FY2028.

guidance.metric: Una project EBITDA per ton margin
guidance.quote: we should be making around 8 % to 10%. But that is still not finalized.
Because your guidance was 30 % to 35% EBITDA CAGR, so I think this year you are planning to beat it, right?
working capital days going forward between 35 to 40 days positive working capital cycle should be going forward.

red_flags.label: Related-party steam purchase from Sanjoo group
red_flags.quote: Steamhouse India Limited is still purchasing steam from Sanjoo Dyeing & Printing Mills Private Limited for Sachin location.

red_flags.label: Gross debt up YoY and QoQ; IPO funds used to reduce debt
red_flags.quote: As of Q1 FY2027, gross debt stood at INR359.48 crores compared with INR281.62 crores at the end of FY2026.

red_flags.label: Management refused to split own-generation vs traded margin
red_flags.quote: we'll not be able to give this details considering the competition sensitiveness.

red_flags.label: Mgmt hedged on maintaining annual growth
red_flags.quote: We are not saying that we will maintain.
